facts.fact: Jin Wang won the Malko Competition in 1992.
Jan Wagner was a recipient of the Malko Competition in 1995.
Mei-Ann Chen won the Malko Competition in 2005.
Tung-Chieh Chuang was awarded the Malko Competition in 2015.
Dmitry Matvienko won the Malko Competition in 2021.

result.summary: The Malko Competition has recognized several notable conductors since 1992, including Jin Wang, Jan Wagner, Mei-Ann Chen, Tung-Chieh Chuang, and Dmitry Matvienko.

The Malko Way - The competition that changed my life

Meet the participants in, and learn the background behind, The Malko Competition for young conductors.

If you win the Danish National Symphony Orchestra's Malko Competition, your life is forever changed. In this documentary, we follow both new and past winners and tell the story of the world's most important conducting competition.

This documentary is produced in connection with the Malko Competition 2024 supported by Fondation Caris.
